objective: Lane-based fragment split re-researches lanes that were already complete. server/services/research/splitting.ts ~L54-63 builds one question per empty lane, but splitFragment (~L109, ~L122) maps lanes to children only when signal.questions.length === fragment.requiredEvidence.length, which never holds for a lane split, so each child inherits every lane including completed ones; a two-question '?' split on a two-lane fragment assigns lanes by index arbitrarily; and slice(0, 4) silently drops a fifth question. CLAUDE.md §15: splitting must not re-research the half that worked. Fix: add laneIds to SplitSignal from the lane branch; splitFragment gives child i exactly the lane named laneIds[i]; a '?' split keeps all lanes; more than four questions is refused/reported rather than truncated.
expectedOutcome: Children of a lane split carry exactly their own lane, and no question is silently dropped.

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/researchLaneSplit.test.ts: a 3-lane fragment with fees filled and vendors/dates empty splits into children whose requiredEvidence is exactly [vendors] and [dates].
A two-question '?' split keeps both lanes on each child, and five questions are not silently truncated.
Existing splitting and repair tests pass and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
